name: Node
description: A swirling blue orb on a pedestal that is a physical node of the Vaar's knowledge, a billion times rarer than moxite, which moves and kills those who seek it.

description_citations.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
description_citations.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The squad finds the glowing blue orb on a pedestal, but the wall reseals itself behind them.
timeline.quote: but the hole itself is gone.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: The artifact vanishes from the room and the radio from Haronar degrades.
timeline.quote: But it's clearly gone, not even a mark where the pedestal was.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Farakatolar and Rakoro find a vast spherical chamber with the artifact on a platform at its center.
timeline.quote: on a small floating platform at the center of the massive space: the artifact.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Farakatolar reaches the artifact and loses contact with Haronar, who is praying.
timeline.quote: it's the desperate mumblings of a prayer.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: A voice declares escape incorrect and that from the many there must be one Vaar; Farakatolar realizes the orb is a node of the Vaar's knowledge.
timeline.quote: The Vaar. It is an old myth.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.

timeline.summary: Farakatolar reaches into the node, is pierced and grips the object inside as she is crushed to death.

citation.work: Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark
citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Grasp in the Dark" by RJ Taylor. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Jun 2025.
